ACTION: Read `docs/sync.md`, to check line 12 before I edit it.

ACTION: Edit `docs/sync.md:12`. Change `--dry_run` to `--dry-run`.

ACTION: Commit `docs/sync.md` alone with the message "docs: fix --dry-run flag name in sync.md".

ACTION: Append a note to the Task 3 implementer's report file in `.sdd/14-buoy-sync/`. The note says I changed one flag name in `docs/sync.md:12`. It says the change alters no behavior, and no test covers it because no code or test reads that file.

ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package specs/plans/14-buoy-sync.md <base> <new head>` to write the diff file. Use the commit range that `fix-loop.md` names.

ACTION: Dispatch the scoped re-review with model `sonnet`, using `re-review-prompt.md`. The prompt names the diff file path from `review-package` and F1 as the reviewer wrote it. It also carries the Task 3 spec text and the binding constraints from the plan. The reviewer reports ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED for F1 and any new Critical or Important issue. The prompt does not rate F1 or tell the reviewer what to skip.

Task 3 review found one Important issue: `docs/sync.md:12` says `--dry_run`, but the code uses `--dry-run`. This is a docs-only fix and changes no behavior, so I fixed it myself and committed it. A scoped re-review is running. I will mark Task 3 complete in the ledger when it comes back clean.
